attempt_history.llm_sketch:
The workflow validates successfully. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_btp_001
steps:
  - id: receive_upload
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      method: POST
      endpoint: /api/v1/medical-docs/upload
      accept: application/pdf
    output: upload_payload

  - id: authenticate_admin
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      token: "{{upload_payload.auth_token}}"
      required_role: admin
    output: auth_result

  - id: validate_pdf
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: "{{upload_payload.file}}"
      rules:
        mime_type: application/pdf
        max_size_mb: 50
    output: validation_result

  - id: generate_filename
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      url: "{{config.ai_vision_api_url}}/analyze"
      method: POST
      headers:
        Content-Type: application/pdf
        Authorization: "Bearer {{config.ai_vision_api_key}}"
      body: "{{upload_payload.file.binary}}"
      response_format: json
    output: ai_response

  - id: format_filename
    op: format_output
    params:
      template: "{{ai_response.standardized_filename}}.pdf"
    output: final_filename

  - id: encrypt_document
    op: encrypt_field
    params:
      field: "{{upload_payload.file.binary}}"
      algorithm: AES-256-GCM
    output: encrypted_content

  - id: store_document
    op: write_database
    params:
      collection: medical_documents
      document:
        filename: "{{final_filename}}"
        content: "{{encrypted_content}}"
        uploaded_by: "{{auth_result.user_id}}"
        uploaded_at: "{{now}}"
        content_type: application/pdf
        size_bytes: "{{upload_payload.file.size}}"
    output: stored_record

  - id: audit_log_entry
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: medical_document_upload
      actor: "{{auth_result.user_id}}"
      role: admin
      resource: "{{stored_record.document_id}}"
      filename: "{{final_filename}}"
      timestamp: "{{now}}"
      status: success
